paragraph: Cresskill is a single-family town first, with 44 detached sales over six months at a median of $1,317,500 against a $1,300,000 median list. The sale-to-list ratio sits right at 1.00, about 43 percent of homes sold above asking, and the median days on market is 20. That is competitive but not frenzied. Good homes priced correctly move quickly, and the rest wait. The range runs from $698,000 to $4,299,000, so the median is the better guide than either end. The monthly series is worth reading: February through May were thin, three to seven closings a month, too small to call a trend, but June brought 11 sales at $1,335,000 and July brought 16 at $1,475,000. Volume and median climbing together into midsummer is the seasonal peak doing what it usually does here. If Cresskill follows the normal Bergen arc, expect closings and medians to ease through fall. Condos and townhouses are a small slice, 5 sales at a median of $940,000, moving in 14 days with a sale-to-list ratio of 1.01. Five sales is not enough to build a strategy on. If you are comparing the two, the deciding factor is whether you want the space and grounds of a single-family or the low-maintenance setup of a townhouse.
